item.title: As Fallout 76 considers a second raid, Bethesda is plotting new loadout options so you can "play the game, not the UI"
item.description: As the possibility of a second Fallout 76 raid looms, Bethesda tells me why challenge is important and discusses new loadout options.

item.title: Arc Raiders' new event rewards friendliness over violence, but I'm just thankful it's not a PvE mode
item.description: Arc Raiders' Shared Watch event rewards you for teaming up and scrapping robots, and the Cold Snap map condition is back in rotation too.

item.title: Blizzard agrees that Overwatch's "Ozempic-chic" Anran design could be "better," hopes to update it during Season 1
item.description: Overwatch developer Blizzard has come under fire for Anran’s generic character design, but the team is already working on a change.

item.title: My Logitech G Pro X2 Superstrike gaming mouse review isn't one I want to rush, as this is a true game-changer
item.description: With a ground-breaking new analog click technology, including offering rapid trigger, Logitech's new gaming mouse isn't simple to assess.

item.title: Escape From Tarkov's first crossover has arrived, and all it took was a trigger-happy rubber duck
item.description: Escape From Tarkov and Escape From Duckov celebrate each others’ different flavors of extraction mayhem in their new crossover updates.

item.title: Upcoming Blade Runner game delisted on Steam after all members of the development team resign
item.description: Blade Runner 2033 Labyrinth appears to be the first victim of Annapurna Interactive’s public collapse, as it can’t be searched on Steam.

item.title: Grab Crimson Desert for $0 thanks to AMD's new free game offer
item.description: Bag yourself a free copy of Crimson Desert with select purchases of AMD Ryzen CPUs, Radeon RX GPUs, and laptops for the next few months.

item.title: Farming Simulator 15 casually adds Steam Trading Cards, and I can get a shiny cow for the price of a Starbucks
item.description: Farming Simulator 25 joins the ranks of countless other games in offering Steam Trading Cards, but the prices made me double-take.

item.title: Nioh 3 Kodama locations
item.description: Here are all the Nioh 3 Kodama locations we've found so far, so reap the Kodama Merits and extra Elixir capacity awarded for your service.

item.title: The new Overwatch season is a fresh start for Blizzard, and its five new heroes will change the meta for the better
item.description: Overwatch Season 1 is proof that Blizzard has finally locked in, introducing a roadmap for 2026 that is set to change the game forever.
